new_or_high_risk_candidates_reviewed.overlap: Continuous accessible ground floor, public readability and public-service rooms.
new_or_high_risk_candidates_reviewed.material_difference: Its ground is an accessible public-realm and ground-floor network; it defines no passive symbol grammar jointly read by people and multi-vendor robots.

new_or_high_risk_candidates_reviewed.overlap: Ground materials, accessibility, robot inspection and reversible surface testing.
new_or_high_risk_candidates_reviewed.material_difference: Its core is a surface/subsurface section, environmental sensing and Ground Passport; tactile navigation and robots are separate scenarios, not one shared six-word public grammar.

new_or_high_risk_candidates_reviewed.overlap: Multisensory accessibility, tactile routes and predictable service-robot interaction.
new_or_high_risk_candidates_reviewed.material_difference: Its core is service equivalence for different human bodies and senses; it does not define an open, passive, cross-vendor ground dictionary shared by humans and robots.

new_or_high_risk_candidates_reviewed.overlap: Vendor-neutral interfaces, robot pilots, versioning and rollback.
new_or_high_risk_candidates_reviewed.material_difference: Its core is a three-speed carrier and plugin lifecycle; the interface is architectural and operational rather than a shared visual-tactile-machine ground language.

core_claim_zh: 一套置于公共地面的开放、被动、可触知语法，使行人、盲杖与轮椅使用者以及不同厂商机器人读取相同的空间状态，并要求机器遵守居民能理解的规则。
core_claim_en: An open, passive and tactile public-ground grammar lets pedestrians, blind-cane and wheelchair users, and robots from different vendors read the same spatial state, requiring machines to obey rules residents can understand.
